mapper.sql: select order_item_id, sum(if(status in ('REJECTED', 'CANCELLED'), 0, quantity)) as used_quantity, sum(status not in ('REJECTED', 'CANCELLED', 'COMPLETED')) as open_count from aftersales_order group by order_item_id
mapper.select: select o.id as order_id, o.order_no, o.status as order_status, o.placed_at, o.completed_at, o.after_sale_days, oi.id as item_id, oi.product_name, oi.color, oi.size, oi.quantity as item_quantity, oi.unit_price, oi.quantity - ifnull(occ.used_quantity, 0) as after_saleable_quantity, ifnull(occ.open_count, 0) as open_count from shop_order o join order_item oi on oi.order_id = o.id left join () occ on occ.order_item_id = oi.id where o.user_id = #{userId} order by o.id desc, oi.id

select oi.id as itemId, oi.product_name as productName, oi.color, oi.size, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price as unitPrice, oi.quantity - ifnull(occ.used_quantity, 0) as afterSaleableQuantity, o.id as orderId, o.order_no as orderNo, o.status as orderStatus, o.user_id as orderUserId, o.completed_at as completedAt, o.after_sale_days as afterSaleDays from order_item oi join shop_order o on o.id = oi.order_id left join () occ on occ.order_item_id = oi.id where oi.id = #{itemId}
